Name: Desert Fishing Iridium Quality
Author: metalax
Description:
Uses TMXLoader to edit the desert map to expand the pond allowing for Iridium quality fish to be caught. Only the tiles in the 10x12 area of the pond are altered, so it should be compatible with any mods that alter other areas of the map.

[size=4]Installation:[/size]
[list=1]
[*] Install [url=https://www.smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]
[*] Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726]PyTK - Platonymous Toolkit[/url]
[*] Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1820]TMXLoader[/url]
[*] Unzip the download and move the [code][TMX] DesertFishingIridiumQuality[/code] folder into [code]../Stardew Valley/Mods[/code].
[*] Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[size=4]Compatibility[/size]
[list=1]
[*] Created with Stardew Valley 1.4 on Windows. Should be fine on Linux/Mac and on previous versions supported by TMXLoader.
[*] Compatible with SMAPI 3.0.0 (untested on earlier versions, but it might still work).
[*] Should be no mod conflicts aside from those that edit the tiles of the pond(let me know if you find one).
[*] Should be fine with any language version.
[/list]

Manifest.Name: (TMX) Desert Fishing Iridium Quality
Manifest.Description: Expands the pond in the Desert to allow for Iridium quality fish.
Manifest.Author: metalax
